messages:
jamie: Quick heads-up — code freeze for v1.8 goes into effect today at 18:00 PT. If you need a late exception, follow the exception flow: post PR link, short risk note, and tag @sasha + @jamie. Small docs or non-runtime fixes preferred.

sasha: Thanks — I have a tiny runtime bump PR (#5678) that only updates a dependency patch. Size: 1 file, unit tests updated. Is that ok to request an exception?

release-bot: :alarm_clock: RELEASE NOTICE: v1.8 freeze in ~2h 30m. Reminder: only emergency or low-risk exceptions. See #eng-releases pinned doc for process.

jamie: @sasha please paste the PR link and the test CI status. If CI green and changelog note present, we can fast-track. Also include the minimal cherry-pick command when ready:```\n git fetch origin\n git checkout release/v1.8\n git cherry-pick -x <commit>\n ```

mike: FYI staging smoke passed for the canary this morning (smoke-suite v2.1). No regressions on key endpoints. :white_check_mark:

jamie: great — that helps. If anyone expects the frozen branch to be bumped again after cut, we should schedule rollforward (canary -> stable) tomorrow morning.

olivia: Changelog owners — pinging @team-changelog to confirm entries. I added a placeholder for the dependency bump.

release-bot: :pushpin: Exception queue updated: 2 open requests. Exception review cadence: every 30m until freeze.

jamie: @taylor you mentioned a CSV parser fix earlier — is that going to be a runtime change or just a small validation tweak? Need PR link + risk note to decide.

taylor: It's a small logic fix that prevents a crash on malformed rows. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/5721 . Touches parser core but has unit + integration tests. Risk: medium-low, rollout mitigations include feature flag and probe on canary.

sasha: Looking at the PR now. Tests good, but it changes parsing order slightly. Can you add a short canary probe to fail fast if we see increased parse errors? If yes, we can approve with a staged rollout.

taylor: Will add probe by EOD. If jamie approves exception, I'll cherry-pick to release/v1.8 and include the probe as a follow-up canary-only commit.

jamie: Ok — approve conditional on probe added and CI green. Tag me once probe commit is in. :thumbsup:

mike: One last ops note — if we do any rollforward tomorrow, coordinate with infra for extra capacity between 09:00-11:00 PT. I'll take point.

olivia: Noted. I'm updating the release checklist with approved exceptions and probe tasks. Will post final freeze reminder 30m before cutoff.

release-bot: :mega: FINAL REMINDER: v1.8 code freeze in 30 minutes. Post exceptions now or they won't be accepted.
